items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Gil was a bachelor, he had nobody living with him but a cat named Becky.

ctx.x: Kind of dank and airless, but who cares, it went twenty-four hours a day, music played, Gil was a bachelor, he had nobody living with him but a cat named Becky. And we were there, you know he was sort of like a big den mother, he loved being with the younger guys, he didn’t care about at all with being with his contemporaries, which was another generation really. And he was anything but a father figure.
He said of that period, I guess, that he wanted what he called, “musical companionship,” because he said he hadn’t had much of it.
